cards.t: Binance Futures Lists Predict.fun Pre-Market Perpetuals

cards.t: Bitcoin Wallet Bug Allowed Fund Theft During Fee Bumps
cards.b: A vulnerability in Bitcoin wallets allowed rogue servers to replace legitimate transactions with fake ones when users sped up payments, leading to at least one confirmed loss before developers issued a patch.

per.BTC: Wallet fee-bump bug exploited by rogue servers before being patched.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total amount of funds stolen across all affected users.

cards.t: Upbit Puts Initia on Warning List

per.INIT: Placed on Upbit warning list with deposits and withdrawals paused.
